name: smwmusic-grateful-dead-scarlet-begonias
title: Grateful Dead - Scarlet Begonias
description:
Scarlet Begonias is a reggae-infused psychedelic rock song by American band The Grateful Dead. Featuring clean and distorted guitars, organs, electric bass, drums, and a bit of SMW's steel drums. Perfect for a laid-back beach level or anything on the water.


"She had rings on her fingers and bells on her shoes. I knew without asking she was into the blues."
